task_description: Fix Google Sign-In on the 4A Store v2 mobile app by migrating from expo-auth-session's Google provider (blocked custom-URI-scheme Android flow) to the native @react-native-google-signin/google-signin library, which produces a WEB-client idToken the existing /social-login server endpoint already verifies. Verify the web storefront GIS path (config-only) and document owner Google Cloud / rebuild requirements.
